title: Myrtle Beach Half-Day Fishing Adventure
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Set sail on a spacious and comfortable vessel for a half-day fishing adventure in Myrtle Beach. With two decks and convenient amenities, including restrooms and a snack bar, this trip is designed for all ages to enjoy. Experienced captains guide you to prime fishing spots where you can reel in black sea bass, flounder, and more. Whether you’re a seasoned angler or trying fishing for the first time, the crew is there to assist you. Bring your personal cooler or purchase snacks onboard as you soak up the sun and enjoy the thrill of fishing in the open water.
